components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single readout action — cyan fill, used once per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; padding: 14px 26px; border-radius: 10px; background: #5ee7e0; color: #062b29; transition: transform .2s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1), box-shadow .3s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 14px 40px -8px rgba(94,231,224,0.55); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5ee7e0; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary .ds-arrow { transition: transform .2s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover .ds-arrow { transform: translate(3px,-3px); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action — hairline border, cyan on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 14px; text-decoration: none; padding: 14px 26px; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: #eef1f7; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14); transition: transform .2s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1), border-color .25s, color .25s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: #5ee7e0; color: #5ee7e0; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5ee7e0; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; padding: 24px; border-radius: 18px; background: #10131e; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); text-decoration: none; color: inherit; transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1), border-color .35s, box-shadow .35s; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); box-shadow: 0 30px 60px -24px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); } .ds-card-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; gap: 16px; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 21px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #eef1f7; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; font-family: 'Sora', sans-serif; font-size: 15.5px; color: #aab2c5; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-card-arrow { width: 38px; height: 38px; flex: none; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14); border-radius: 10px; color: #aab2c5; transition: background .25s, color .25s; } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-arrow { background: #5ee7e0; color: #062b29; } .ds-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-top: auto; } .ds-tag { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11.5px; color: #aab2c5; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); padding: 5px 11px; border-radius: 7px; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Live availability readout with an animated green pulse.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12.5px; color: #aab2c5; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); padding: 7px 14px; border-radius: 100px; } .ds-pulse { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #4ade80; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(74,222,128,0.6); animation: ds-pulse 2.2s infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(74,222,128,0.5); } 70% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 9px rgba(74,222,128,0); } 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(74,222,128,0); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-pulse { animation: none; } }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Monospace nav link, Ink Soft to Ink on hover with a faint fill.

narrative.overview: A precision tool read in low light. The surface is near-black (#07080d), the labels are exacting monospace, and a single electric-cyan signal color (#5ee7e0) acts as the readout — the one thing that glows. Everything is placed with intent; nothing is decorative. Depth comes from tonal panel layering and hairline borders, not heavy chrome. Type carries the hierarchy: a tight grotesque display for headings, a humanist sans for reading, and a mono reserved for labels. Motion is tactile and responsive — surfaces lift, the accent pulses where status matters — but choreography never gets in the way of the work.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black instrument surface with tonal panel layering, not flat black.
One electric-cyan signal color; violet is a rare secondary accent only.
Monospace as the labeling system — metadata, eyebrows, nav, tags.
Hairline borders and soft glows over hard shadows and heavy chrome.
Tactile, responsive motion: lift, glow, pulse — never gratuitous.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Cyan is the instrument's single readout. Use it on ≤10% of any screen. The moment two things glow cyan, neither reads as the signal.

rules.name: The Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: Body copy uses Ink Soft (#aab2c5) or lighter on dark panels — never Ink Mute (#6b7488) for anything meant to be read. Verify ≥4.5:1 against the actual panel.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Metadata Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono labels structure, never prose. Sentences are Sora; legends, tags, timestamps, and nav are mono.

rules.name: The Tracking Floor Rule
rules.body: Display headings never go tighter than -0.04em. -0.025em is correct; do not crush further.

rules.name: The Glow-Not-Chrome Rule
rules.body: Emphasis is a soft accent glow or tonal lift, never a hard drop shadow on a resting surface. Surfaces are flat at rest.

dos: Do keep cyan as the single signal — primary action, live status, the one focal glow (≤10% of any screen).
Do build depth by tonal panel layering and hairline borders; reserve shadow for hover-lift and glow for accents.
Do use JetBrains Mono for labels, tags, nav, and metadata only — prose is Sora.
Do keep card radii ≤18px and button radii at 10px.
Do provide a genuine prefers-reduced-motion alternative for the particle background, glow drift, pulse, and reveal transitions.
Do verify body text hits ≥4.5:1 on its actual panel; lift toward Ink before reaching for Ink Mute.
donts: Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text over a gradient) — banned outright; emphasize with weight, size, or solid cyan.
Don't stack a tracked-uppercase eyebrow above every section; vary the cadence.
Don't ship numbered section markers (01 / 02 / 03) as default scaffolding unless the section genuinely is an ordered sequence.
Don't use repeating-linear-gradient stripe fills as decorative thumbnail/section backgrounds — use real screenshots or a flat tonal panel.
Don't let it drift corporate-SaaS, flashy/overdesigned, or cluttered: no hero-metric template, no neon overload, no airless walls of text.
Don't crush display tracking past -0.04em or push the hero clamp past ~76px.
Don't add a second glowing color next to cyan, or promote violet to a co-lead.
